title: Frogger's Adventures - Temple of the Frog (USA) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)

fields.name: slot_unlock_flags
fields.description: Four slot/initials flags; bit i selects slot i in the 4-slot apply loop (cleared bits get default initials). Whole byte must stay below 0x10.
fields.evidence: FUN_08017364 tests ((uStack_28 & 0xff) >> uVar11) & 1 for uVar11 in 0..3 (4 slots) and requires (byte)uStack_28 < 0x10; loaded from EEPROM block 0 by FUN_080177a0 via FUN_080178fc via FUN_08033a70 (0x0D000000). Logical save offset 0 == RAM buffer byte 0.

fields.name: language_option
fields.description: Language/option selector, validated to 0..4 (5 values matching the 5-language En,Fr,De,Es,It ROM). Baseline 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08017364 rejects the save unless (byte)(uStack_28._1_1_) < 5, i.e. logical save offset 1 in 0..4; loaded by FUN_080177a0 (EEPROM block 0) and stored back by FUN_080177d8.

fields.name: difficulty_option
fields.description: Unchecked middle option byte between the validated option bytes; preserved verbatim across EEPROM load/store. Baseline 0.
fields.evidence: Logical save offset 2 (uStack_28 byte 2) is copied by FUN_080177a0/FUN_080177d8 8-byte block transfer (FUN_080178fc/FUN_0801789c, EEPROM block 0) with no range check in FUN_08017364 validation.

fields.name: validity_guard_zero
fields.description: Must be zero; FUN_08017364 treats any nonzero value as a corrupt save and resets to factory defaults. Baseline 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08017364 requires uStack_28._3_1_ == 0 (logical save offset 3), else it zeroes the buffer, restores ROM defaults and rewrites EEPROM via FUN_080177d8.

fields.name: sound_fx_flag
fields.description: Feature enable flag; zero takes the FUN_08020bf0 disabled path, nonzero skips it. Part of the factory 01 01 05 05 options word (DAT_08017508 / FUN_08000430).
fields.evidence: FUN_08017364 gates on *pcVar6 (logical save offset 4, uStack_24 byte 0): if zero calls FUN_08020bf0 (in the 08020bxx audio/apply family); default 1 written by builtin_strncpy(DAT_08017508, "\x01\x01\x05\x05", 4) and by FUN_08000430.

fields.name: music_flag
fields.description: Feature enable flag; zero takes the FUN_08020c3c path, nonzero takes FUN_08020c58 which sets status bit 0x10 and applies via FUN_08020e98 12-entry applier.
fields.evidence: FUN_08017364 gates on pcVar6[1] (logical save offset 5, uStack_24 byte 1): zero calls FUN_08020c3c, nonzero calls FUN_08020c58 -> FUN_08020e98; default 1 from DAT_08017508 "\x01\x01\x05\x05" default word.

fields.name: lives_count
fields.description: Gameplay counter in range 3..9, factory default 5 (second 05 of the 01 01 05 05 word).
fields.evidence: FUN_08017364 requires (byte)(uStack_24._2_1_ - 3) < 7, i.e. logical save offset 6 in [3,9]; default 5 written by FUN_08000430 (*DAT_080004b4 bytes) and the DAT_08017508 default word.

fields.name: continues_count
fields.description: Gameplay counter in range 3..9, factory default 5 (third 05 of the 01 01 05 05 word).
fields.evidence: FUN_08017364 requires (byte)(uStack_24._3_1_ - 3) < 7, i.e. logical save offset 7 in [3,9]; default 5 written by FUN_08000430 and the DAT_08017508 default word.
